title: Mission
notes: Generic single-checkpoint plan for any repository. The mission file is the contract; the repository's own instructions govern validation. Copy this file to ~/.agent-review/plans/<name>.json and add intermediate checkpoints when a mission has phases worth reviewing separately.

exit_conditions: Every requirement of the mission is implemented, with evidence appropriate to each claim; no requirement is weakened or silently dropped.
Validation follows the repository's own instructions; commands, results and limits are reported honestly.
Deviations, limitations and deferred optional items are stated explicitly, separate from required work.
